---
name: Output quality
about: Share generic, repetitive, or weak decision output
title: "[Output quality]: "
labels: output-quality
---

## Decision Type

Example: launch, pricing, hiring, pivot, client risk, market entry

## Skill Version and Platform

Example: `0.2.0` on Codex

## What Felt Weak?

- [ ] Too generic
- [ ] Repetitive lenses
- [ ] Ignored constraints
- [ ] No real disagreement
- [ ] Vague next action
- [ ] Invented evidence

## Sanitized Prompt and Output

Remove private information, secrets, client data, credentials, financial records, and regulated data before posting.
